# proxmox_sdn_apply (Resource)

Commits the staged Proxmox VE SDN configuration through `PUT /cluster/sdn` and waits for the cluster-wide network reload. Zone, VNet and subnet resources only stage changes, so this is the single explicit activation step. Destroy is a no-op: a committed configuration stays committed. A failed commit keeps the instance in state for a retry, and a release of the global lock is attempted on failure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Commits every staged zone/VNet/subnet change in one cluster-wide reload and
# waits for the reload task. Bump a trigger whenever staged SDN configuration
# changed; a robust trigger is a hash over the managed objects.
# Destroying this resource does not undo the commit.
# Provider credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn.
resource "proxmox_sdn_apply" "cluster" {
  triggers = {
    revision = sha1(jsonencode([
      for zone in [proxmox_sdn_zone.lab, proxmox_sdn_zone.vlan] : [zone.id, zone.type, zone.bridge, zone.mtu, zone.nodes]
    ]))
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when a commit is due; changing any of them re-applies. Use a hash over the managed SDN objects, for example `{ revision = sha1(jsonencode([...])) }`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier.
- `pending` (List of String) Staged objects Proxmox still reports as pending, formatted as `<type> <id> (<state>)`. Empty after a successful commit.
- `pending_objects` (Map of String) Staged zones keyed by zone id, valued with their staging state.
